description: Crawl a website from a start URL: follows links on the same site and scrapes each page it finds, up to `max_pages`. Suited to getting many pages from one site, such as a docs section or a blog. Waits up to `wait_for_completion_seconds` (default 45) and returns the scraped pages when the crawl finishes in that time. Larger crawls return a crawl_id instead, and `get_crawl_results` returns their pages once done. Crawls and batches are separate resources, so a crawl_id works with `get_crawl_results`, not `get_batch_results`.

country.description: Optional country code for location-specific crawling.

max_pages.description: Maximum number of pages to crawl. Set to 1 to scrape only the start URL.

parser.description: Optional parser ID for specialized content extraction.

wait_for_completion_seconds.description: Seconds to wait for the crawl to finish and return its pages in this call. 0 returns the crawl_id right away.
